```{r}
# ============================================================
# Reproducible Environment Setup
# ============================================================

# 1. Set a consistent random seed for all stochastic steps
set.seed(20251113L)

# 2. Fix the random number generator algorithms
RNGkind(kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion", sample.kind = "Rounding")

# 3. Global options for modeling consistency
options(
  contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"),  # fixed factor coding
  na.action = "na.exclude"                         # keeps residuals aligned with data
)

# 4. Load required packages quietly
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
require(here)
require(readxl)
require(tidyverse)
require(dplyr)
require(lubridate)
require(tidyr)
require(knitr)
require(ggplot2)
require(mice)
require(gridExtra)
require(grid)
})

# 5. (Optional but good practice) Lock locale and timezone
Sys.setenv(TZ = "UTC")

# ============================================================
# End setup
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# Read in data
REP4.1 <- read_excel("/Users/levchenko/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/WCER/2025/REP/Master_REP4.1.xlsx")

# ---- Lock row order + factor baselines (prevents silent flips) ----
REP4.1 <- REP4.1 %>%
  arrange(student_id) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Control","REP")),
    gender    = factor(gender)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# --- Deterministic, locale-safe type updates ----------------------------------

# 1) Convert Excel serial date to Date (works even if birthdate was character)
REP4.1 <- REP4.1 %>%
  mutate(
    birthdate = as.Date(as.numeric(birthdate), origin = "1899-12-30")
  )

# 2) Columns that should NOT be numerically coerced
exclude <- c("student_id", "state", "school", "gender", "birthdate", "condition")

# 3) Deterministic character -> numeric coercion (trim, drop thousands commas)
#    and fixed factor baselines for ANCOVA
REP4.1 <- REP4.1 %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = -all_of(exclude),
      .fns = ~{
        if (is.character(.x)) {
          x <- stringr::str_trim(.x)
          x <- gsub(",", "", x, fixed = TRUE)      # remove thousands separators deterministically
          out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))   # stable coercion
          if (any(is.na(out) & !is.na(x))) {
            warning(sprintf("Column %s: non-numeric values coerced to NA.", cur_column()))
          }
          out
        } else {
          .x
        }
      }
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Control", "REP")),
    gender    = factor(gender)
  ) %>%
  arrange(student_id) %>%   # 4) Lock row order for reproducible modeling
  droplevels()

# 5) Remove participants without a valid condition (treat literal "NA" as missing)
REP4.1 <- REP4.1 %>%
  mutate(condition = na_if(as.character(condition), "NA") |> factor(levels = c("Control","REP"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition))

```


# Data Manipulation

## SRCS

Fully complete data for one scenario: That’s the one we choose
Fully complete data on both scenarios: Randomly select one of them 
Partially complete data on both scenarios: Randomly select and impute data at the item level

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
# === Reproducible, deterministic SRCS chooser (all-in-one chunk) ===============

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(digest)   # for stable hashing
})

# 1) Helper: safe hex -> integer (returns 0L on NA)
.hex2int <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(strtoi(x, base = 16L))
  ifelse(is.na(v), 0L, as.integer(v))
}

# 2) Deterministic SRCS selector (no RNG; choices keyed by student & wave)
choose_srcs_items <- function(items1, items2, key) {
  items1 <- as.numeric(items1)
  items2 <- as.numeric(items2)
  L      <- length(items1)

  nmis1   <- sum(is.na(items1))
  nmis2   <- sum(is.na(items2))
  all_na1 <- (nmis1 == L)
  all_na2 <- (nmis2 == L)

  # A) both scenarios entirely missing
  if (all_na1 && all_na2) {
    return(list(
      total         = NA_real_,
      used_scenario = NA_integer_,
      imputed       = FALSE,
      reason        = "all_missing_both_scenarios"
    ))
  }

  # B) exactly one complete
  if (nmis1 == 0L && nmis2 > 0L) {
    return(list(
      total         = sum(items1),
      used_scenario = 1L,
      imputed       = FALSE,
      reason        = "scenario1_complete_scenario2_incomplete"
    ))
  }

  if (nmis2 == 0L && nmis1 > 0L) {
    return(list(
      total         = sum(items2),
      used_scenario = 2L,
      imputed       = FALSE,
      reason        = "scenario2_complete_scenario1_incomplete"
    ))
  }

  # C) both complete -> deterministic pick by hash of the key
  if (nmis1 == 0L && nmis2 == 0L) {
    h    <- digest(paste0(as.character(key), "|both_complete"), algo = "xxhash64")
    pick <- (.hex2int(substr(h, 1L, 8L)) %% 2L) + 1L  # 1 or 2

    total <- if (pick == 1L) sum(items1) else sum(items2)

    return(list(
      total         = total,
      used_scenario = pick,
      imputed       = FALSE,
      reason        = "both_complete_hash_pick"
    ))
  }

  # D) both partial -> per-item deterministic mix using hash per item index
  both_present_idx <- which(!is.na(items1) & !is.na(items2))
  only_s1_idx      <- which(!is.na(items1) &  is.na(items2))
  only_s2_idx      <- which( is.na(items1) & !is.na(items2))

  mixed <- rep(NA_real_, L)
  mixed[only_s1_idx] <- items1[only_s1_idx]
  mixed[only_s2_idx] <- items2[only_s2_idx]

  if (length(both_present_idx) > 0L) {
    pick_s1 <- vapply(both_present_idx, function(j) {
      hj <- digest(paste0(as.character(key), "|item:", j), algo = "xxhash64")
      (.hex2int(substr(hj, 1L, 8L)) %% 2L) == 0L  # TRUE -> take scenario 1 item
    }, logical(1))

    mixed[both_present_idx[pick_s1]]  <- items1[both_present_idx[pick_s1]]
    mixed[both_present_idx[!pick_s1]] <- items2[both_present_idx[!pick_s1]]
  }

  total <- if (all(is.na(mixed))) NA_real_ else sum(mixed, na.rm = TRUE)

  list(
    total         = total,
    used_scenario = NA_integer_,
    imputed       = TRUE,
    reason        = "hybrid_item_level_hash_mix"
  )
}

# 3) Column name vectors
pre_items1  <- paste0("pre_SRCS_scenario1_item",  1:16)
pre_items2  <- paste0("pre_SRCS_scenario2_item",  1:16)
post_items1 <- paste0("post_SRCS_scenario1_item", 1:16)
post_items2 <- paste0("post_SRCS_scenario2_item", 1:16)

# Make sure your starting data frame is NOT called `data()`
# For example, if your main dataset is REP4.1:
rep_df <- REP4.1

# ---- MAIN PIPELINE ----
rep_df <- rep_df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(student_id) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pre_SRCS_result = list(choose_srcs_items(
      c_across(all_of(pre_items1)),
      c_across(all_of(pre_items2)),
      key = paste0(as.character(student_id), "|pre")
    )),
    post_SRCS_result = list(choose_srcs_items(
      c_across(all_of(post_items1)),
      c_across(all_of(post_items2)),
      key = paste0(as.character(student_id), "|post")
    )),
    pre_SRCS_final          = pre_SRCS_result$total,
    post_SRCS_final         = post_SRCS_result$total,
    pre_SRCS_used_scenario  = pre_SRCS_result$used_scenario,
    post_SRCS_used_scenario = post_SRCS_result$used_scenario,
    pre_SRCS_imputed        = pre_SRCS_result$imputed,
    post_SRCS_imputed       = post_SRCS_result$imputed
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -pre_SRCS_result,
    -post_SRCS_result
  )

# If you really want the name `data` later:
data <- rep_df
```

# Data Summary

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
# --- Build a clean analysis frame of the variables you want to summarize ------
# We:
#  1) Select only analysis variables (pre/post outcomes + grouping var `condition`)
#  2) Coerce `condition` to a factor so downstream models/summaries are consistent
summary_data <- data %>% 
  select(
    pre_student_BFS_internalizing,  post_student_BFS_internalizing,
    pre_student_BFS_externalizing,  post_student_BFS_externalizing,
    pre_student_BFS_total,          post_student_BFS_total,
    pre_YSR_Anxious_Depressed,      post_YSR_Anxious_Depressed,
    pre_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed,    post_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed,
    pre_YSR_SomaticComplaints,      post_YSR_SomaticComplaints,
    pre_YSR_SocialProblems,         post_YSR_SocialProblems,
    pre_YSR_InternalizingProblems,  post_YSR_InternalizingProblems,
    pre_PCOISS,                     post_PCOISS,
    pre_SRCS_final,                 post_SRCS_final,
    pre_CASSS_caregiver,            post_CASSS_caregiver,
    pre_CASSS_teacher,              post_CASSS_teacher,
    condition
  ) %>%
  mutate(condition = as.factor(condition))   # pin class of the grouping var

# --- Helper that returns a compact 6-number summary for a single column -------
# Notes:
#  * Works for both numeric and non-numeric inputs.
#  * For numeric, it mirrors `summary()` output order and also returns a non-missing count.
#  * For non-numeric (e.g., `condition`), it returns Count and NAs for the numeric stats,
#    so the output shape stays consistent across columns.
compute_summary <- function(column) {
  if (is.numeric(column)) {
    ss <- summary(column)  # named vector: Min., 1st Qu., Median, Mean, 3rd Qu., Max.
    c(
      Count   = sum(!is.na(column)),
      Min     = ss["Min."],
      `1st_Qu`= ss["1st Qu."],
      Median  = ss["Median"],
      `3rd_Qu`= ss["3rd Qu."],
      Max     = ss["Max."]
    )
  } else {
    c(
      Count   = sum(!is.na(column)),
      Min     = NA_real_,
      `1st_Qu`= NA_real_,
      Median  = NA_real_,
      `3rd_Qu`= NA_real_,
      Max     = NA_real_
    )
  }
}

# --- Apply the helper to every column and shape it into a tidy table ----------
# Steps:
#  1) `sapply(summary_data, compute_summary)` applies our function to each column,
#     producing a matrix-like object with rows = statistic, cols = variable.
#  2) `t()` transposes so rows = variables and cols = statistics (more readable).
#  3) `as.data.frame()` gives a data frame; we then set friendly column names.
# Reproducibility:
#  * This step is deterministic given `summary_data`; no RNG is used here.
summary_df <- as.data.frame(t(sapply(summary_data, compute_summary)))

# Give the columns human-friendly labels in a fixed order
colnames(summary_df) <- c("Count", "Min", "1st_Qu", "Median", "3rd_Qu", "Max")

# Optional: keep the variable names as an explicit column for easier printing/joins
summary_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(summary_df, var = "Variable")

# Print the summary table (you can also `knitr::kable(summary_df)` in Rmd)
print(summary_df)
```

# Multiple Imputation

## BFS

### Student Pre-BFS Internalizing (pre_student_BFS_internalizing)

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
# ============================
# Imputation block: pre_student_BFS_internalizing
# Reproducible + consistent
# ============================

# ----- 0) Repro settings (use your global seed if you already set one) -----
IMPUTE_SEED <- 20251113L   # change in one place to re-run deterministically

# helper to produce a deterministic sub-seed for any label (so order changes won't matter)
seed_for <- function(label, base = IMPUTE_SEED) {
  # stable integer hash from a string label
  # (kept simple: sums of char codes; for more entropy you could use digest::digest)
  sum(as.integer(charToRaw(paste0(label, "|", base)))) %% .Machine$integer.max
}

# ----- 1) Define candidate predictors (excluding the DV we impute) ----------
# ----- 1) Define candidate predictors (excluding the DV we impute) ----------
available_predictors <- c(
  # BFS
  "pre_student_BFS_internalizing",  "post_student_BFS_internalizing",
  "pre_student_BFS_externalizing",  "post_student_BFS_externalizing",
  "pre_student_BFS_total",          "post_student_BFS_total",

  # YSR
  "pre_YSR_Anxious_Depressed",      "post_YSR_Anxious_Depressed",
  "pre_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed",    "post_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed",
  "pre_YSR_SomaticComplaints",      "post_YSR_SomaticComplaints",
  "pre_YSR_SocialProblems",         "post_YSR_SocialProblems",
  "pre_YSR_InternalizingProblems",  "post_YSR_InternalizingProblems",

  # PCOISS
  "pre_PCOISS",                     "post_PCOISS",

  # SRCS
  "pre_SRCS_final",                 "post_SRCS_final",

  # CASSS
  "pre_CASSS_caregiver",            "post_CASSS_caregiver",
  "pre_CASSS_teacher",              "post_CASSS_teacher",

  # BESS Teacher (add these)
  "pre_teacher_BESS_ERI", "post_teacher_BESS_ERI",
  "pre_teacher_BESS_IRI", "post_teacher_BESS_IRI",
  "pre_teacher_BESS_ARI", "post_teacher_BESS_ARI",
  "pre_teacher_BESS_BERI","post_teacher_BESS_BERI",

  # Demographics
  "gender",
  "condition"
)

# ---- 2) Deterministic singleton predictor sets ------------------------------
predictor_sets <- list(
  set1  = c("gender"),
  set2  = c("condition"),

  # BFS
  set3  = c("post_student_BFS_internalizing"),
  set4  = c("pre_student_BFS_externalizing"),
  set5  = c("post_student_BFS_externalizing"),
  set6  = c("pre_student_BFS_total"),
  set7  = c("post_student_BFS_total"),

  # YSR
  set8  = c("pre_YSR_Anxious_Depressed"),
  set9  = c("post_YSR_Anxious_Depressed"),
  set10 = c("pre_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed"),
  set11 = c("post_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed"),
  set12 = c("pre_YSR_SomaticComplaints"),
  set13 = c("post_YSR_SomaticComplaints"),
  set14 = c("pre_YSR_SocialProblems"),
  set15 = c("post_YSR_SocialProblems"),
  set16 = c("pre_YSR_InternalizingProblems"),
  set17 = c("post_YSR_InternalizingProblems"),

  # PCOISS
  set18 = c("pre_PCOISS"),
  set19 = c("post_PCOISS"),

  # SRCS
  set20 = c("pre_SRCS_final"),
  set21 = c("post_SRCS_final"),

  # CASSS
  set22 = c("pre_CASSS_caregiver"),
  set23 = c("post_CASSS_caregiver"),
  set24 = c("pre_CASSS_teacher"),
  set25 = c("post_CASSS_teacher"),

  # ---- BESS Teacher (added) ----
  set26 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_ERI"),
  set27 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ERI"),
  set28 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  set29 = c("post_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  set30 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set31 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set32 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_BERI"),
  set33 = c("post_teacher_BESS_BERI")
)

# ----- 2) Deterministic expansion with all 2- and 3-way combos --------------
generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  # combn is deterministic given same inputs
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    # enforce a deterministic label per combo (comma-joined) for reproducible ordering
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    # sort by label to guarantee the same order across R versions/locales
    ord <- order(lbl)
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

# append up to 1000 deterministic combos to predictor_sets (without duplicates)
max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  # label is deterministic; skip if already present
  lbl <- paste(cmb, collapse = ", ")
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}

# ----- 3) RMSE utility (deterministic masking + deterministic mice) ----------
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(mask_frac), mask_frac >= 0, mask_frac <= 1)
  target <- "pre_student_BFS_internalizing"

  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  # deterministic loop order
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]

  rmses <- numeric(length(set_names))

  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]

    # Build simulation frame deterministically
    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))

    n <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)

    # Deterministic indices to mask for this set
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }

    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_

    # Deterministic mice for this set
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m = 5, maxit = 10,
      method = "pmm",
      seed = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmses[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }

  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmses)
}

# ----- 4) Compute RMSEs and choose best set deterministically -----------------
rmse_tbl <- run_rmse_calculations(data, predictor_sets)
print(rmse_tbl)

best_row <- which.min(rmse_tbl$RMSE)                 # deterministic tie-break (first min)
best_set_name <- rmse_tbl$Set_Name[best_row]
best_predictors <- predictor_sets[[best_set_name]]

cat("Best predictor set:", best_set_name, "\n")
cat("Variables in the best predictor set:", paste(best_predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("RMSE of the best predictor set:", rmse_tbl$RMSE[best_row], "\n")

# ----- 5) Fit the final imputation model on the real data deterministically ---
data_sim_best <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(best_predictors, "pre_student_BFS_internalizing")))

# Deterministic final mice run
set.seed(seed_for("MICE|FINAL|pre_student_BFS_internalizing"))
imp_best <- mice::mice(
  data_sim_best,
  m = 5, maxit = 10,
  method = "pmm",
  seed = seed_for("MICE-INTERNAL|FINAL|pre_student_BFS_internalizing"),
  printFlag = FALSE
)
comp_best <- mice::complete(imp_best)

# Merge back: only replace NAs in original with imputed values
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Imputed_pre_student_BFS_internalizing = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(pre_student_BFS_internalizing),
      comp_best$pre_student_BFS_internalizing,
      pre_student_BFS_internalizing
    )
  )
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  set23 = c("post_CASSS_caregiver"),
  set24 = c("pre_CASSS_teacher"),
  set25 = c("post_CASSS_teacher"),
  
  # BESS teacher (added)
  set26 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_ERI"),
  set27 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ERI"),
  set28 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  set29 = c("post_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  set30 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set31 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set32 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_BERI"),
  set33 = c("post_teacher_BESS_BERI")

generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    ord <- order(lbl)               # stable order across runs/machines
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  # include only if not a duplicate (ignoring order)
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}

# 3) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]  # fixed loop order

  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))

  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]

    data_sim <- df %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    n <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)

    # deterministic mask indices for this set + target
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }

    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_

    # deterministic mice seeds for this set + target
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m = 5, maxit = 10,
      method = "pmm",
      seed = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }

  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

rmse_tbl <- run_rmse_calculations(data, predictor_sets)
print(rmse_tbl)

best_row <- which.min(rmse_tbl$RMSE)                  # deterministic tie-break
best_set_name <- rmse_tbl$Set_Name[best_row]
best_predictors <- predictor_sets[[best_set_name]]

cat("Best predictor set:", best_set_name, "\n")
cat("Variables in the best predictor set:", paste(best_predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("RMSE of the best predictor set:", rmse_tbl$RMSE[best_row], "\n")

# 4) Final deterministic imputation on real data
data_sim_best <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(best_predictors, TARGET)))

set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|FINAL|", TARGET)))
imp_best <- mice::mice(
  data_sim_best,
  m = 5, maxit = 10,
  method = "pmm",
  seed = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|FINAL|", TARGET)),
  printFlag = FALSE
)
comp_best <- mice::complete(imp_best)

# Replace only the NAs in the original with imputed values
out_name <- paste0("Imputed_", TARGET)
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    !!out_name := dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(.data[[TARGET]]),
      comp_best[[TARGET]],
      .data[[TARGET]]
    )
  )
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    ord <- order(lbl)              # stable lexical order = reproducible
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  # Add only if not already present (ignoring order)
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}

# 3) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]  # fixed loop order for reproducibility

  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))

  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]

    data_sim <- df %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    n <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)

    # deterministic mask indices for this set + target
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }

    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_

    # deterministic mice seeds for this set + target
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m = 5, maxit = 10,
      method = "pmm",
      seed = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }

  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
# 3) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
```
```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]  # fixed order

  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))

  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]

    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    n <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)

    # deterministic mask indices for this set + target
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }

    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_

    # deterministic mice seeds for this set + target
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
```
```{r, warning= F, message= F}
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }

  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {

    }

    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_

    # deterministic mice seeds for this set + target
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }

  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)

# 3) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))

  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {

      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))

    # deterministic mask indices for this set + target
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }

    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_

    # deterministic mice seeds for this set + target
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }

  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

      printFlag = FALSE
    )
```
```{r, warning= F, message= F}
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }
  
  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  # SRCS

  # CASSS
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  "pre_teacher_BESS_BERI", "post_teacher_BESS_BERI",

  # Demo + condition (added)
  "gender",
  "condition"
)


# 2) Hand-picked 1-variable sets + expansion to 2- and 3-variable sets
predictor_sets <- list(
  set1  = c("gender"),
  set2  = c("condition"),

  # BFS variables
  set3  = c("pre_student_BFS_internalizing"),
  set4  = c("post_student_BFS_internalizing"),
  set5  = c("pre_student_BFS_externalizing"),
  set6  = c("post_student_BFS_externalizing"),
  set7  = c("pre_student_BFS_total"),
  set8  = c("post_student_BFS_total"),

  # YSR variables
  set9  = c("pre_YSR_Anxious_Depressed"),
  set10 = c("post_YSR_Anxious_Depressed"),
  set11 = c("pre_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed"),
  set12 = c("post_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed"),
  set13 = c("pre_YSR_SomaticComplaints"),
  set14 = c("post_YSR_SomaticComplaints"),
  set15 = c("pre_YSR_SocialProblems"),
  set16 = c("post_YSR_SocialProblems"),
  set17 = c("post_YSR_InternalizingProblems"),

  # PCOISS variables
  set18 = c("pre_PCOISS"),
  set19 = c("post_PCOISS"),

  # SRCS variables
  set20 = c("pre_SRCS_final"),
  set21 = c("post_SRCS_final"),

  # CASSS variables
  set22 = c("pre_CASSS_caregiver"),
  set23 = c("post_CASSS_caregiver"),
  set24 = c("pre_CASSS_teacher"),
  set25 = c("post_CASSS_teacher"),

  # Teacher BESS variables
  set26 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_ERI"),
  set27 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ERI"),
  set28 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  set29 = c("post_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  set30 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set31 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set32 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_BERI"),
  set33 = c("post_teacher_BESS_BERI")
)


generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    ord <- order(lbl)  # fixed lexical order for reproducibility
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  # only add if not already present (order-agnostic check)
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}

# 3) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]  # fixed order
  
  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))
  
  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]
    
    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    n      <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)
    
    # deterministic mask indices for this set + target
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }
    
    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_
    
    # deterministic mice seeds for this set + target
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)
    
    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }
  
  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

rmse_tibble <- run_rmse_calculations(data, predictor_sets)
print(rmse_tibble)

best_row        <- which.min(rmse_tibble$RMSE)

best_predictors <- predictor_sets[[best_set_name]]

cat("RMSE of the best predictor set:", rmse_tibble$RMSE[best_row], "\n")

# 4) Final deterministic imputation on real data

  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(best_predictors, TARGET)))

  data_sim_best,
  m         = 5,
  maxit     = 10,

  seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|FINAL|", TARGET)),
  printFlag = FALSE
)

out_name <- paste0("Imputed_", TARGET)

  dplyr::mutate(
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    ord <- order(lbl)  # fixed lexical order for reproducibility
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  # only add if not already present (order-agnostic check)
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}

# 3) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]  # fixed order
  
  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))
  
  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]
    
    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    n      <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)
    
    # deterministic mask indices
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }
    
    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_
    
    # deterministic mice seeds
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)
    
    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }
  
  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

print(rmse_tibble)
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  # Demographics
  "gender",
  "condition"
)


# 2) Hand-picked 1-variable predictor sets (plus condition)
predictor_sets <- list(
  set1  = c("gender"),
  set2  = c("condition"),
  
  # BFS
  set3  = c("pre_student_BFS_internalizing"),
  set4  = c("post_student_BFS_internalizing"),
  set5  = c("pre_student_BFS_externalizing"),

  set20 = c("post_PCOISS"),

  set25 = c("post_CASSS_teacher"),

  # Teacher BESS (added)

  set27 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ERI"),

  set30 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set31 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set32 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_BERI"),
  set33 = c("post_teacher_BESS_BERI")
)

# 3) Expand to all 2- and 3-variable combinations in a deterministic order -----
generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    ord <- order(lbl)  # fixed lexical order for reproducibility
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
```
```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  # Only add if not already present (order-agnostic comparison)
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}

# 4) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice ---------------
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]  # fixed iteration order
  
  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))
  
  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]
    
    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    
    n      <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)
    
    # deterministic mask indices for this target + set
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }
    
    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_
    
    # deterministic mice seeds for this target + set
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)
    
    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }
  
  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

rmse_tibble <- run_rmse_calculations(data, predictor_sets)
print(rmse_tibble)

# 5) Choose best predictor set based on RMSE ------------------------------------
best_row        <- which.min(rmse_tibble$RMSE)
best_set_name   <- rmse_tibble$Set_Name[best_row]
best_predictors <- predictor_sets[[best_set_name]]

cat("Best predictor set:", best_set_name, "\n")
cat("Variables in the best predictor set:",
    paste(best_predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("RMSE of the best predictor set:", rmse_tibble$RMSE[best_row], "\n")

# 6) Final deterministic imputation on the real data ---------------------------

  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(best_predictors, TARGET)))

  dplyr::mutate(

    )
  )
```

```{r, warning= F, message= F}
  set33 = c("post_teacher_BESS_BERI")
)


# 3) Expand to all 2- and 3-variable combinations in a deterministic order -----
generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    ord <- order(lbl)  # fixed lexical order for reproducibility
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  # Only add if not already present (order-agnostic comparison)
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}

# 4) RMSE utility with deterministic masking + deterministic mice ---------------
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]  # fixed iteration order
  
  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))
  
  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]
    
    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    
    n      <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)
    
    # deterministic mask indices for this target + set
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      idx <- integer(0)
    }
    
    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_
    
    # deterministic mice seeds for this target + set
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)
    
    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }
  
  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

rmse_tibble <- run_rmse_calculations(data, predictor_sets)
print(rmse_tibble)

# 5) Choose best predictor set based on RMSE ------------------------------------
best_row        <- which.min(rmse_tibble$RMSE)
best_set_name   <- rmse_tibble$Set_Name[best_row]
best_predictors <- predictor_sets[[best_set_name]]

cat("Best predictor set:", best_set_name, "\n")
cat("Variables in the best predictor set:",
    paste(best_predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("RMSE of the best predictor set:", rmse_tibble$RMSE[best_row], "\n")

# 6) Final deterministic imputation on the real data ---------------------------
```

```{r}
  set31 = c("post_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  set32 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_BERI"),
  set33 = c("post_teacher_BESS_BERI")
)


# 3) Expand to all 2–3 variable combinations (deterministic order) -------------
generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    ord <- order(lbl)
    out <- c(out, cmb[ord])
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}


# 4) RMSE utility ---------------------------------------------------------------
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {
  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]
  
  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))
  
  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {
    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]
    
    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))
    
    n      <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)
    
    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else idx <- integer(0)
    
    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_
    
    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)
    imputed_values <- comp[[target]][idx]
    
    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, imputed_values)
  }
  
  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

rmse_tibble <- run_rmse_calculations(data, predictor_sets)
print(rmse_tibble)


# 5) Select best predictor set --------------------------------------------------
best_row        <- which.min(rmse_tibble$RMSE)
best_set_name   <- rmse_tibble$Set_Name[best_row]
best_predictors <- predictor_sets[[best_set_name]]

cat("Variables in the best predictor set:", paste(best_predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("RMSE:", rmse_tibble$RMSE[best_row], "\n")


# 6) Final deterministic imputation --------------------------------------------

  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(best_predictors, TARGET)))

  dplyr::mutate(
```

```{r}
  set22 = c("post_SRCS_final"),

  set24 = c("post_CASSS_caregiver"),
  set25 = c("pre_CASSS_teacher"),
```

```{r}
  set32 = c("pre_teacher_BESS_BERI"),
  set33 = c("post_teacher_BESS_BERI")
)


# 3) Deterministic expansion to 2- and 3-variable combinations -----------------
generate_combinations <- function(predictors, min_size, max_size) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in min_size:max_size) {
    cmb <- combn(predictors, k, simplify = FALSE)
    lbl <- vapply(cmb, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
    out <- c(out, cmb[order(lbl)])  # reproducible lexical order
  }
  out
}

combos_2_3 <- generate_combinations(available_predictors, 2, 3)

max_total_sets <- 1000L
for (cmb in combos_2_3) {
  if (length(predictor_sets) >= max_total_sets) break
  if (!any(vapply(predictor_sets, function(x) identical(sort(x), sort(cmb)), logical(1)))) {
    predictor_sets[[paste0("set", length(predictor_sets) + 1L)]] <- cmb
  }
}


# 4) RMSE evaluation -----------------------------------------------------------
calculate_rmse <- function(original, imputed) {
  sqrt(mean((original - imputed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

run_rmse_calculations <- function(df, predictor_sets, target = TARGET, mask_frac = 0.10) {

  stopifnot(target %in% names(df))
  set_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  set_names <- set_names[order(set_names)]

  rmse <- numeric(length(set_names))

  for (i in seq_along(set_names)) {

    sname <- set_names[i]
    preds <- predictor_sets[[sname]]

    data_sim <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(preds, target)))

    n      <- nrow(data_sim)
    n_mask <- floor(mask_frac * n)

    if (n_mask > 0) {
      set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MASK|", target, "|", sname)))
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n_mask, replace = FALSE)
    } else idx <- integer(0)

    original_values <- data_sim[[target]][idx]
    data_sim[[target]][idx] <- NA_real_

    set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|", target, "|", sname)))
    imp <- mice::mice(
      data_sim,
      m         = 5,
      maxit     = 10,
      method    = "pmm",
      seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|", target, "|", sname)),
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
    comp <- mice::complete(imp)

    rmse[i] <- calculate_rmse(original_values, comp[[target]][idx])
  }

  tibble::tibble(Set_Name = set_names, RMSE = rmse)
}

rmse_tibble <- run_rmse_calculations(data, predictor_sets)
print(rmse_tibble)


# 5) Best predictor set ---------------------------------------------------------
best_row        <- which.min(rmse_tibble$RMSE)
best_set_name   <- rmse_tibble$Set_Name[best_row]
best_predictors <- predictor_sets[[best_set_name]]

cat("Best predictor set:", best_set_name, "\n")
cat("Variables:", paste(best_predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("RMSE:", rmse_tibble$RMSE[best_row], "\n")


# 6) Final deterministic imputation -------------------------------------------
data_sim_best <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(best_predictors, TARGET)))

set.seed(seed_for(paste0("MICE|FINAL|", TARGET)))
imp_best <- mice::mice(
  data_sim_best,
  m         = 5,
  maxit     = 10,
  method    = "pmm",
  seed      = seed_for(paste0("MICE-INTERNAL|FINAL|", TARGET)),
  printFlag = FALSE
)

comp_best <- mice::complete(imp_best)

out_name <- paste0("Imputed_", TARGET)

data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    !!out_name := dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(.data[[TARGET]]),
      comp_best[[TARGET]],
      .data[[TARGET]]
    )
  )
```

# Analysis

## Model Output
```{r, warning= F, message= F}
# ============================================================
# ANCOVA WITH TIDY OUTPUT, COHEN'S D, & FULL MODEL PRINTING
# ============================================================

# Global reproducible seed
set.seed(20251113L)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare data: check DVs/covariates and condition factor
# ------------------------------------------------------------
prepare_data <- function(data, dv_list, cov_list, condition_var) {
  
  missing_dvs  <- setdiff(dv_list, colnames(data))
  missing_covs <- setdiff(cov_list, colnames(data))
  
  if (length(missing_dvs) > 0)
    stop("Missing DVs: ", paste(missing_dvs, collapse = ", "))
  if (length(missing_covs) > 0)
    stop("Missing covariates: ", paste(missing_covs, collapse = ", "))
  
  if (!is.factor(data[[condition_var]])) {
    data[[condition_var]] <- factor(data[[condition_var]])
  }
  
  data
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compute Cohen’s d (Control vs REP)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
compute_cohens_d <- function(data, dv, group_var,
                             treatment_level = "REP",
                             control_level = "Control") {
  
  g1 <- data[[dv]][data[[group_var]] == control_level]
  g2 <- data[[dv]][data[[group_var]] == treatment_level]
  
  g1 <- g1[!is.na(g1)]
  g2 <- g2[!is.na(g2)]
  
  if (length(g1) < 2 || length(g2) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  
  m1 <- mean(g1); m2 <- mean(g2)
  sd1 <- sd(g1);  sd2 <- sd(g2)
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((length(g1)-1)*sd1^2 + (length(g2)-1)*sd2^2) /
                    (length(g1)+length(g2)-2))
  
  if (pooled_sd == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  (m1 - m2) / pooled_sd
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Model specifications — now includes TEACHER BESS
# ============================================================

analyses <- list(
  # BFS
  list(DV="Imputed_post_student_BFS_internalizing",  Cov="Imputed_pre_student_BFS_internalizing"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_student_BFS_externalizing",  Cov="Imputed_pre_student_BFS_externalizing"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_student_BFS_total",          Cov="Imputed_pre_student_BFS_total"),

  # YSR
  list(DV="Imputed_post_YSR_Anxious_Depressed",      Cov="Imputed_pre_YSR_Anxious_Depressed"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed",    Cov="Imputed_pre_YSR_Withdrawn_Depressed"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_YSR_SomaticComplaints",      Cov="Imputed_pre_YSR_SomaticComplaints"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_YSR_SocialProblems",         Cov="Imputed_pre_YSR_SocialProblems"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_YSR_InternalizingProblems",  Cov="Imputed_pre_YSR_InternalizingProblems"),

  # PCOISS
  list(DV="Imputed_post_PCOISS",                     Cov="Imputed_pre_PCOISS"),

  # SRCS
  list(DV="Imputed_post_SRCS_final",                 Cov="Imputed_pre_SRCS_final"),

  # CASSS
  list(DV="Imputed_post_CASSS_caregiver",            Cov="Imputed_pre_CASSS_caregiver"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_CASSS_teacher",              Cov="Imputed_pre_CASSS_teacher"),

  # ============================
  # NEW: TEACHER BESS MEASURES
  # ============================
  list(DV="Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_ERI",           Cov="Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_ERI"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_IRI",           Cov="Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_ARI",           Cov="Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_ARI"),
  list(DV="Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_BERI",          Cov="Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_BERI")
)

dv_list  <- sapply(analyses, `[[`, "DV")
cov_list <- sapply(analyses, `[[`, "Cov")

condition_var <- "condition"
data_combined <- prepare_data(data, dv_list, cov_list, condition_var)

# ============================================================
# 4. Run models, print full summaries, and build tidy table
# ============================================================

results_tbl <- map_dfr(analyses, function(a) {
  
  dv <- a$DV
  cv <- a$Cov
  
  form <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", cv, "+", condition_var))
  
  subset_data <- data_combined %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dv]]) & !is.na(.data[[cv]]) & !is.na(.data[[condition_var]]))
  
  model <- lm(form, data = subset_data)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # PRINT FULL MODEL OUTPUT
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\n\n==============================\n")
  cat(" FULL MODEL OUTPUT FOR:", dv, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n")
  print(summary(model))
  
  tidy_mod <- tidy(model)
  
  cond_rows <- tidy_mod %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, paste0("^", condition_var)))
  
  if (nrow(cond_rows) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      DV          = dv,
      Covariate   = cv,
      estimate    = NA,
      std.error   = NA,
      statistic   = NA,
      p.value     = NA,
      Sample_Size = nrow(subset_data),
      Cohens_d    = NA
    ))
  }
  
  d_value <- compute_cohens_d(subset_data, dv, condition_var)
  
  cond_rows %>%
    mutate(
      DV          = dv,
      Covariate   = cv,
      Sample_Size = nrow(subset_data),
      Cohens_d    = d_value
    ) %>%
    select(
      DV, Covariate,
      estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value,
      Sample_Size, Cohens_d
    )
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PRINT TIDY MODEL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n\n==============================\n")
cat(" TIDY CONSOLIDATED RESULTS TABLE \n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(results_tbl)
```

## Regression Assumption Checks
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Regression Assumption Checks for Each ANCOVA Model
# Reproducible + self-contained helper
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(car)        # vif(), durbinWatsonTest()
  library(lmtest)     # bptest()
})

# Safe evaluation helper
safe <- function(expr, default = NA_real_) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) default)
}

run_assumption_checks <- function(data, analyses, condition_var = "condition") {
  
  assumption_results <- tibble(
    Model = character(),
    n     = integer(),
    k     = integer(),      # number of parameters (incl. intercept)
    VIF_Max = numeric(),
    BP_p     = numeric(),
    Shapiro_p= numeric(),
    DW_p     = numeric(),
    Cooks_Max= numeric(),
    Cooks_4n = numeric(),   # 4/n threshold
    Leverage_Max = numeric(),
    Lev_2k_n    = numeric(),# 2k/n threshold
    Lev_3k_n    = numeric() # 3k/n threshold
  )
  
  for (analysis in analyses) {
    # Allow both "Covariate" and "Cov" field names
    DV <- analysis$DV
    Covariate <- if (!is.null(analysis$Covariate)) {
      analysis$Covariate
    } else if (!is.null(analysis$Cov)) {
      analysis$Cov
    } else {
      stop("Each element of `analyses` must have either `Covariate` or `Cov` defined.")
    }
    
    if (is.null(DV)) {
      stop("Each element of `analyses` must have a `DV` field.")
    }
    
    fmla <- as.formula(paste(DV, "~", Covariate, "+", condition_var))
    
    subset_data <- data %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[DV]]),
        !is.na(.data[[Covariate]]),
        !is.na(.data[[condition_var]])
      )
    
    if (nrow(subset_data) < 3) next
    
    model <- lm(fmla, data = subset_data)
    
    n_obs <- nrow(subset_data)
    k_par <- length(coef(model))  # intercept + covariate + condition
    
    # --- Metrics (all deterministic given data/model) ---
    vif_max   <- safe(max(vif(model), na.rm = TRUE))
    bp_p      <- safe(bptest(model)$p.value)
    
    # Shapiro often unhelpful at very large N; skip for N > 5000
    shapiro_p <- if (n_obs > 5000) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      safe(shapiro.test(residuals(model))$p.value)
    }
    
    dw_p      <- safe(durbinWatsonTest(model)$p)
    cooks_vec <- safe(cooks.distance(model), default = rep(NA_real_, n_obs))
    cooks_max <- suppressWarnings(max(cooks_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
    cooks_4n  <- 4 / n_obs
    
    lev_vec   <- safe(hatvalues(model), default = rep(NA_real_, n_obs))
    lev_max   <- suppressWarnings(max(lev_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
    lev_2k_n  <- 2 * k_par / n_obs
    lev_3k_n  <- 3 * k_par / n_obs
    
    assumption_results <- assumption_results %>%
      add_row(
        Model        = DV,
        n            = n_obs,
        k            = k_par,
        VIF_Max      = vif_max,
        BP_p         = bp_p,
        Shapiro_p    = shapiro_p,
        DW_p         = dw_p,
        Cooks_Max    = cooks_max,
        Cooks_4n     = cooks_4n,
        Leverage_Max = lev_max,
        Lev_2k_n     = lev_2k_n,
        Lev_3k_n     = lev_3k_n
      )
  }
  
  # --- Flagging + Interpretation (purely deterministic transforms) ---
  assumption_results %>%
    mutate(
      # Flags
      Flag_VIF       = !is.na(VIF_Max)      & VIF_Max > 5,
      Flag_BP        = !is.na(BP_p)         & BP_p < 0.05,
      Flag_Shapiro   = !is.na(Shapiro_p)    & Shapiro_p < 0.05,
      Flag_DW        = !is.na(DW_p)         & DW_p < 0.05,
      Flag_Cooks_1   = !is.na(Cooks_Max)    & Cooks_Max > 1,
      Flag_Cooks_4n  = !is.na(Cooks_Max)    & Cooks_Max > Cooks_4n,
      Flag_Lev_2k    = !is.na(Leverage_Max) & Leverage_Max > Lev_2k_n,
      Flag_Lev_3k    = !is.na(Leverage_Max) & Leverage_Max > Lev_3k_n,
      
      # Text notes
      VIF_note = case_when(
        is.na(VIF_Max)               ~ "VIF not computed",
        VIF_Max <= 5                 ~ "No meaningful multicollinearity",
        VIF_Max > 5  & VIF_Max <= 10 ~ "Moderate multicollinearity; monitor",
        VIF_Max > 10                 ~ "High multicollinearity; consider remedies"
      ),
      BP_note = case_when(
        is.na(BP_p)  ~ "BP not computed",
        BP_p >= 0.05 ~ "Homoskedastic residuals (fail to reject)",
        BP_p < 0.05  ~ "Heteroskedasticity detected"
      ),
      Shapiro_note = case_when(
        is.na(Shapiro_p) & n > 5000 ~ "Normality test skipped (very large N); inspect QQ plot",
        is.na(Shapiro_p)           ~ "Shapiro not computed",
        Shapiro_p >= 0.05          ~ "Residuals approx. normal",
        Shapiro_p < 0.05           ~ "Non-normal residuals (often OK if N is moderate/large)"
      ),
      DW_note = case_when(
        is.na(DW_p)  ~ "DW not computed",
        DW_p >= 0.05 ~ "No autocorrelation detected",
        DW_p < 0.05  ~ "Autocorrelation detected (consider clustered/time effects)"
      ),
      Cooks_note = case_when(
        is.na(Cooks_Max)                      ~ "Cook's not computed",
        Cooks_Max <= Cooks_4n                 ~ "No influential points by 4/n rule",
        Cooks_Max > Cooks_4n & Cooks_Max <= 1 ~ "Some influence (4/n rule); review cases",
        Cooks_Max > 1                         ~ "Highly influential case(s) (Cook's > 1)"
      ),
      Lev_note = case_when(
        is.na(Leverage_Max)                                 ~ "Leverage not computed",
        Leverage_Max <= Lev_2k_n                            ~ "Leverage within typical range",
        Leverage_Max > Lev_2k_n & Leverage_Max <= Lev_3k_n  ~ "Elevated leverage; review",
        Leverage_Max > Lev_3k_n                             ~ "High leverage; inspect"
      ),
      
      Suggested_Action = paste(
        ifelse(Flag_VIF,
               "Check coding of condition/pre; center/standardize covariate; consider removing redundant predictors.",
               ""),
        ifelse(Flag_BP,
               "Use robust SEs (HC3) with sandwich::vcovHC + lmtest::coeftest, or model variance (e.g., GLS).",
               ""),
        ifelse(Flag_Shapiro & (n <= 5000),
               "Inspect QQ plot; consider robust/bootstrapped SEs; transformations if severe.",
               ifelse(is.na(Shapiro_p) & n > 5000,
                      "Use QQ plot instead of Shapiro at very large N.", "")),
        ifelse(Flag_DW,
               "If data are clustered, use cluster-robust SEs or mixed models with random effects.",
               ""),
        ifelse(Flag_Cooks_1 | Flag_Cooks_4n,
               "Identify high Cook’s cases; run sensitivity analysis; verify data entry.",
               ""),
        ifelse(Flag_Lev_2k | Flag_Lev_3k,
               "Inspect high-leverage cases; check for outliers/mismeasurement; consider robust regression.",
               ""),
        sep = " "
      ) %>% str_squish(),
      
      Any_Flag = Flag_VIF | Flag_BP | (Flag_Shapiro & (n <= 5000)) |
                 Flag_DW  | Flag_Cooks_1 | Flag_Cooks_4n | Flag_Lev_3k
    ) %>%
    select(
      Model, n, k,
      VIF_Max, VIF_note,
      BP_p, BP_note,
      Shapiro_p, Shapiro_note,
      DW_p, DW_note,
      Cooks_Max, Cooks_4n, Cooks_note,
      Leverage_Max, Lev_2k_n, Lev_3k_n, Lev_note,
      Any_Flag, Suggested_Action
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Any_Flag), Model)
}

# ----- Run once (reproducible given data_combined + analyses) ----------------
assumption_results <- run_assumption_checks(
  data         = data_combined,
  analyses     = analyses,
  condition_var = condition_var
)

cat("\n=== Assumption Check Summary (with interpretations) ===\n")
print(assumption_results, n = Inf)
```

## Robust Standard Errors
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Re-run ANCOVA models with fixes:
# - DV ~ pre + condition for each imputed outcome
# - HC3 robust SEs for all models
# - Returns tidy table with robust estimates, p-values, CI, and Cohen's d
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(broom)
  library(sandwich)  # vcovHC
  library(lmtest)    # coeftest
})

# ---- Cohen's d helper --------------------------------------
compute_cohens_d <- function(data, dv, group_var,
                             treatment_level = "REP",
                             control_level   = "Control") {
  g_control   <- data[[dv]][data[[group_var]] == control_level]
  g_treatment <- data[[dv]][data[[group_var]] == treatment_level]
  
  n1 <- sum(!is.na(g_control))
  n2 <- sum(!is.na(g_treatment))
  if (n1 < 2 | n2 < 2) return(NA_real_)
  
  m1 <- mean(g_control, na.rm = TRUE)
  m2 <- mean(g_treatment, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd1 <- sd(g_control, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd2 <- sd(g_treatment, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1)*sd1^2 + (n2 - 1)*sd2^2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
  if (is.na(pooled_sd) || pooled_sd == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  # Control - Treatment
  (m1 - m2) / pooled_sd
}

# ---- Main function to fit models with HC3 robust SEs --------
fit_ancova_with_fixes <- function(data,
                                  analyses,
                                  condition_var   = "condition",
                                  treatment_level = "REP",
                                  control_level   = "Control") {
  
  map_dfr(analyses, function(analysis) {
    
    # Allow both Covariate and Cov naming
    DV <- analysis$DV
    Covariate <- if (!is.null(analysis$Covariate)) {
      analysis$Covariate
    } else if (!is.null(analysis$Cov)) {
      analysis$Cov
    } else {
      stop("Each element of `analyses` must have a `DV` and either `Covariate` or `Cov`.")
    }
    if (is.null(DV)) {
      stop("Each element of `analyses` must have a `DV` field.")
    }
    
    fmla <- as.formula(paste(DV, "~", Covariate, "+", condition_var))
    
    subdat <- data %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[DV]]),
        !is.na(.data[[Covariate]]),
        !is.na(.data[[condition_var]])
      )
    
    if (nrow(subdat) < 3) return(NULL)
    
    # Fit classical ANCOVA
    model <- lm(fmla, data = subdat)
    
    # HC3 robust vcov
    vcov_hc3 <- sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC3")
    ct       <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = vcov_hc3)
    
    # Convert to tibble
    res <- broom::tidy(ct) %>%
      mutate(
        df       = model$df.residual,
        conf.low = estimate - qt(0.975, df = df) * std.error,
        conf.high= estimate + qt(0.975, df = df) * std.error
      )
    
    # Compute Cohen's d for the condition effect
    d_val <- compute_cohens_d(
      data            = subdat,
      dv              = DV,
      group_var       = condition_var,
      treatment_level = treatment_level,
      control_level   = control_level
    )
    
    # Mark which row is the condition effect (e.g., "conditionREP")
    condition_row <- grepl(paste0("^", condition_var), res$term)
    
    res %>%
      mutate(
        DV       = DV,
        n        = nrow(subdat),
        Cohens_d = ifelse(condition_row, d_val, NA_real_)
      ) %>%
      select(
        DV, term,
        estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value,
        conf.low, conf.high,
        n, Cohens_d
      )
  })
}

# ---- Run the fixed models -----------------------------------
ancova_results_robust <- fit_ancova_with_fixes(
  data            = data_combined,
  analyses        = analyses,
  condition_var   = condition_var,   # "condition"
  treatment_level = "REP",
  control_level   = "Control"
)

condition_only_results <- ancova_results_robust %>%
  filter(grepl(paste0("^", condition_var), term)) %>%   # keep only condition term
  select(
    DV,
    term,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    n,
    Cohens_d
  )

condition_only_results
```
Report robust standard errors errors in the final manuscript. The estimates are still significant.

## Evidence Relevant to Missing at Random (MAR) Statement

```{r manuscript-mar-evidence, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# Evidence relevant to the MAR assumption
# ============================================================

analysis_raw_vars <- unique(missingness_variable_map$Variable)
analysis_raw_vars <- intersect(analysis_raw_vars, names(data))

predictor_pool <- unique(c(analysis_raw_vars, "gender", "condition"))
predictor_pool <- intersect(predictor_pool, names(data))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Test whether missingness is associated with observed variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

test_missingness <- function(target, predictor, df) {

  if (target == predictor) return(NULL)

  analytic <- tibble::tibble(
    missing = as.integer(is.na(df[[target]])),
    predictor = df[[predictor]]
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(predictor))

  if (
    nrow(analytic) < 10 ||
    dplyr::n_distinct(analytic$missing) < 2 ||
    dplyr::n_distinct(analytic$predictor) < 2
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (is.numeric(analytic$predictor)) {

    fit <- tryCatch(
      stats::glm(
        missing ~ predictor,
        data = analytic,
        family = stats::binomial()
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

    p_value <- tryCatch(
      summary(fit)$coefficients["predictor", "Pr(>|z|)"],
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )

    method <- "Logistic regression"

  } else {

    tab <- table(analytic$missing, analytic$predictor)
    chi <- suppressWarnings(
      tryCatch(stats::chisq.test(tab), error = function(e) NULL)
    )

    if (!is.null(chi) && all(chi$expected >= 5)) {
      p_value <- chi$p.value
      method <- "Chi-square test"
    } else {
      p_value <- tryCatch(
        stats::fisher.test(tab)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      method <- "Fisher exact test"
    }
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    Target = target,
    Predictor = predictor,
    Method = method,
    N = nrow(analytic),
    P_Value = p_value
  )
}

missingness_association_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(
  analysis_raw_vars,
  function(target) {
    purrr::map_dfr(
      predictor_pool,
      ~ test_missingness(target, .x, data)
    )
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significant = !is.na(P_Value) & P_Value < .05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Target, P_Value)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize evidence by outcome
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mar_evidence_summary <- missingness_association_tests %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Predictors_Tested = dplyr::n(),
    Significant_Associations = sum(Significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    Minimum_P_Value = ifelse(
      all(is.na(P_Value)),
      NA_real_,
      min(P_Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    Significant_Predictors = paste(
      Predictor[Significant],
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significant_Predictors = dplyr::na_if(
      Significant_Predictors,
      ""
    ),
    Interpretation = dplyr::if_else(
      Significant_Associations > 0,
      paste0(
        "Missingness was associated with observed variables in the ",
        "imputation model. This is consistent with an MAR-based approach, ",
        "although MAR cannot be proven."
      ),
      paste0(
        "No significant associations were detected. This does not prove ",
        "MCAR or rule out MAR."
      )
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Little's MCAR test
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mcar_data <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(analysis_raw_vars)) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.x)) > 1)) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ dplyr::n_distinct(.x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1)) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ any(is.na(.x))))

little_mcar_all_outcomes <- if (ncol(mcar_data) >= 2) {
  tryCatch(
    naniar::mcar_test(mcar_data),
    error = function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(
        Note = paste("MCAR test could not be computed:", e$message)
      )
    }
  )
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    Note = "Fewer than two usable variables were available."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save and print results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

readr::write_csv(
  missingness_association_tests,
  "outputs/REP4.1_missingness_association_tests.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  mar_evidence_summary,
  "outputs/REP4.1_mar_evidence_summary.csv"
)

print(little_mcar_all_outcomes)
print(mar_evidence_summary, n = Inf)
```

# BESS Pattern of Missingness (Supplemental)


```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Identify all BESS-related variables (teacher + caregiver)
#    This relies on consistent naming (i.e., "BESS" in the name).
# -----------------------------------------------------------
bess_vars <- REP4.1 %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::contains("BESS")) %>%
  names()

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compute percent missingness for each BESS variable
#    - Output: one row per variable, with % missing
#    - This helps you see which scales/timepoints are most affected.
# -----------------------------------------------------------
bess_missing_tbl <- REP4.1 %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(bess_vars)) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::everything(),
      ~ mean(is.na(.)) * 100   # proportion missing * 100 = percent
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to  = "Variable",
    values_to = "Percent_Missing"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Percent_Missing))

# Quick look at missingness by variable (highest to lowest % missing)
bess_missing_tbl

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Little’s MCAR test for BESS variables
#    - Tests whether missingness is *completely* at random (MCAR).
#    - We restrict to numeric BESS variables (mcar_test requires numeric).
#    - Significant p-value (p < .05) -> NOT MCAR (i.e., some structure).
# -----------------------------------------------------------
bess_numeric <- REP4.1 %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(bess_vars)) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

bess_mcar <- naniar::mcar_test(bess_numeric)
bess_mcar

# Interpretation tip (for your write-up):
# - If p >= .05: fail to reject MCAR -> no evidence against MCAR (but doesn’t prove it).
# - If p <  .05: reject MCAR -> missingness is at least MAR/MNAR; MCAR-based methods
#   like listwise deletion may be biased; MI is preferred.

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Visualize the *pattern* of missingness across BESS variables
#    These plots help see if missingness clusters by person or variable.
#    (Comment out if you are knitting without wanting plots in the PDF.)
# -----------------------------------------------------------

# 4a) Simple heatmap-style view of missingness across rows/columns
# Close any open or corrupted graphics devices
graphics.off()

bess_missing_plot <- naniar::vis_miss(bess_numeric) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Missingness Pattern for BESS Variables")

# print(bess_missing_plot)

# 4b) UpSet-style plot: which combinations of variables tend to be missing together
#     (gg_miss_upset is not a standard ggplot, so don't add + ggtitle())
# naniar::gg_miss_upset(bess_numeric, nsets = 10)

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Explore whether missingness is related to condition or gender
#    - This helps distinguish MCAR vs MAR:
#      * If missingness differs by condition/gender -> likely MAR, not MCAR.
# -----------------------------------------------------------

# (a) Overall percent BESS missingness per student (mean across all BESS vars)
REP4.1 <- REP4.1 %>%
  mutate(
    BESS_missing_prop = bess_numeric %>% 
      # rowwise proportion missing across all BESS variables
      apply(1, function(x) mean(is.na(x)))
  )

# Summarize by condition (e.g., REP vs Control)
bess_missing_by_condition <- REP4.1 %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_students          = n(),
    mean_BESS_missing   = mean(BESS_missing_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_BESS_missing     = sd(BESS_missing_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

bess_missing_by_condition

# Summarize by gender (if coded; adjust levels as needed)
bess_missing_by_gender <- REP4.1 %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_students          = n(),
    mean_BESS_missing   = mean(BESS_missing_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_BESS_missing     = sd(BESS_missing_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

bess_missing_by_gender
```
