# Path Analysis

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PATH ANALYSIS (MEDIATION) FOR REP TRIAL DATA (IMPUTED VARS)
# Intervention (condition) -> Mediator -> Outcome
#
# Outcomes (pre/post):
#  - BFS Total:         Imputed_pre_student_BFS_total,         Imputed_post_student_BFS_total
#  - BESS IRI (teacher):Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_IRI,          Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_IRI
#  - BFS Externalizing: Imputed_pre_student_BFS_externalizing, Imputed_post_student_BFS_externalizing
#  - YSR Social Prob:   Imputed_pre_YSR_SocialProblems,        Imputed_post_YSR_SocialProblems
#  - Teacher BESS ERI:  Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_ERI,          Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_ERI
#
# Mediators (pre/post):
#  - CASSS caregiver:   Imputed_pre_CASSS_caregiver,           Imputed_post_CASSS_caregiver
#  - CASSS teacher:     Imputed_pre_CASSS_teacher,             Imputed_post_CASSS_teacher
#  - PCOISS:            Imputed_pre_PCOISS,                    Imputed_post_PCOISS
#
# Approach:
#  - For each Outcome x Mediator combination:
#      a) M_post ~ condition + M_pre
#      b) Y_post ~ condition + Y_pre + M_post
#     Indirect = a*b; Direct = c'; Total = c' + a*b
#  - Bootstrap CIs for indirect effects
#
# Notes:
#  - This is a "post, controlling for pre" mediation model (ANCOVA-style).
#  - condition is coded as factor in your current pipeline. We create treat01:
#       treat01 = 1 if condition == "REP", else 0 (Control/BAU)
#
# Requires: dplyr, purrr, broom, lavaan
# ============================================================

set.seed(20251113L)

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(broom)
library(lavaan)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Small utility
# ------------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) y else x

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper: check variables exist
# ------------------------------------------------------------
check_vars_exist <- function(data, vars) {
  missing <- setdiff(vars, names(data))
  if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing variables in data: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Helper: create treat01 (0/1) from condition
# ------------------------------------------------------------
make_treat01 <- function(data, condition_var = "condition", treatment_level = "REP") {
  if (!condition_var %in% names(data)) stop("Condition variable not found: ", condition_var)

  if (!is.factor(data[[condition_var]])) data[[condition_var]] <- factor(data[[condition_var]])

  if (!treatment_level %in% levels(data[[condition_var]])) {
    stop("treatment_level '", treatment_level, "' not found in levels(", condition_var, "): ",
         paste(levels(data[[condition_var]]), collapse = ", "))
  }

  data %>%
    mutate(treat01 = if_else(.data[[condition_var]] == treatment_level, 1, 0))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Build lavaan mediation model string (single mediator)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_med_model <- function(m_pre, m_post, y_pre, y_post, treat = "treat01") {
  paste0(
    m_post, " ~ a*", treat, " + ", m_pre, "\n",
    y_post, " ~ b*", m_post, " + cprime*", treat, " + ", y_pre, "\n",
    "ind := a*b\n",
    "total := cprime + ind\n"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Fit one mediation model (returns ONE ROW)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fit_one_mediation <- function(data, condition_var,
                              y_pre, y_post, m_pre, m_post,
                              treatment_level = "REP", boot = 5000,
                              min_n = 25) {

  dat2 <- make_treat01(data, condition_var = condition_var, treatment_level = treatment_level)

  needed <- c("treat01", y_pre, y_post, m_pre, m_post)
  check_vars_exist(dat2, needed)

  dat_model <- dat2 %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(needed), ~ !is.na(.x)))

  if (nrow(dat_model) < min_n) {
    return(tibble(
      Outcome_Post  = y_post,
      Outcome_Pre   = y_pre,
      Mediator_Post = m_post,
      Mediator_Pre  = m_pre,
      N = nrow(dat_model),
      a = NA_real_, b = NA_real_, cprime = NA_real_,
      ind = NA_real_, total = NA_real_,
      ind_ci_low = NA_real_, ind_ci_high = NA_real_, ind_p = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  model_syntax <- build_med_model(m_pre, m_post, y_pre, y_post)

  fit <- sem(
    model_syntax,
    data = dat_model,
    se = "bootstrap",
    bootstrap = boot,
    missing = "listwise"
  )

  pe <- parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, boot.ci.type = "bca.simple")

  a_row     <- pe %>% filter(lhs == m_post, op == "~", rhs == "treat01")
  b_row     <- pe %>% filter(lhs == y_post, op == "~", rhs == m_post)
  c_row     <- pe %>% filter(lhs == y_post, op == "~", rhs == "treat01")
  ind_row   <- pe %>% filter(label == "ind", op == ":=")
  total_row <- pe %>% filter(label == "total", op == ":=")

  tibble(
    Outcome_Post  = y_post,
    Outcome_Pre   = y_pre,
    Mediator_Post = m_post,
    Mediator_Pre  = m_pre,
    N = nrow(dat_model),

    a      = a_row$est %||% NA_real_,
    b      = b_row$est %||% NA_real_,
    cprime = c_row$est %||% NA_real_,

    ind   = ind_row$est %||% NA_real_,
    total = total_row$est %||% NA_real_,

    ind_ci_low  = ind_row$ci.lower %||% NA_real_,
    ind_ci_high = ind_row$ci.upper %||% NA_real_,
    ind_p       = ind_row$pvalue %||% NA_real_
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 5) Specify outcomes and mediators
# ============================================================
outcomes <- list(
  BFS_Total = list(pre="Imputed_pre_student_BFS_total", post="Imputed_post_student_BFS_total"),
  BESS_IRI  = list(pre="Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_IRI",  post="Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_IRI"),
  BFS_Externalizing = list(pre="Imputed_pre_student_BFS_externalizing", post="Imputed_post_student_BFS_externalizing"),
  YSR_SocialProblems = list(pre="Imputed_pre_YSR_SocialProblems", post="Imputed_post_YSR_SocialProblems"),
  Teacher_BESS_ERI = list(pre="Imputed_pre_teacher_BESS_ERI", post="Imputed_post_teacher_BESS_ERI")
)

mediators <- list(
  CASSS_Caregiver = list(pre="Imputed_pre_CASSS_caregiver", post="Imputed_post_CASSS_caregiver"),
  CASSS_Teacher   = list(pre="Imputed_pre_CASSS_teacher",   post="Imputed_post_CASSS_teacher"),
  PCOISS          = list(pre="Imputed_pre_PCOISS",          post="Imputed_post_PCOISS")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Run all Outcome x Mediator models (EXPECT 15 ROWS)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
condition_var   <- "condition"
treatment_level <- "REP"
n_boot          <- 5000

priority_outcomes <- c("BFS_Total", "BESS_IRI")
run_order <- c(priority_outcomes, setdiff(names(outcomes), priority_outcomes))

results_mediation <- map_dfr(run_order, function(o_name) {
  o <- outcomes[[o_name]]
  map_dfr(names(mediators), function(m_name) {
    m <- mediators[[m_name]]
    fit_one_mediation(
      data = data,
      condition_var = condition_var,
      y_pre = o$pre, y_post = o$post,
      m_pre = m$pre, m_post = m$post,
      treatment_level = treatment_level,
      boot = n_boot
    ) %>%
      mutate(Outcome = o_name, Mediator = m_name)
  })
})

# Sanity checks
n_outcomes  <- length(outcomes)
n_mediators <- length(mediators)
expected_models <- n_outcomes * n_mediators

stopifnot(nrow(results_mediation) == expected_models)

# View tidy table (15 rows)
results_mediation %>%
  select(Outcome, Mediator, N, a, b, cprime, ind, ind_ci_low, ind_ci_high, ind_p, total) %>%
  arrange(match(Outcome, run_order), Mediator) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# 7) OPTIONAL: Multi-mediator model per outcome
# ============================================================
build_multiM_model <- function(y_pre, y_post, mediators_list, treat = "treat01") {
  m_posts <- vapply(mediators_list, function(x) x[["post"]], character(1))
  m_pres  <- vapply(mediators_list, function(x) x[["pre"]],  character(1))

  # a-paths (treat -> each mediator post, controlling mediator pre)
  a_lines <- Map(function(mpost, mpre) paste0(mpost, " ~ a_", mpost, "*", treat, " + ", mpre),
                 m_posts, m_pres)

  # correlate mediator posts
  cor_lines <- character(0)
  if (length(m_posts) > 1) {
    combs <- combn(m_posts, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    cor_lines <- vapply(combs, function(z) paste0(z[1], " ~~ ", z[2]), character(1))
  }

  # outcome regression
  b_terms <- paste0("b_", m_posts, "*", m_posts, collapse = " + ")
  y_line  <- paste0(y_post, " ~ ", b_terms, " + cprime*", treat, " + ", y_pre)

  # defined indirects + totals
  ind_defs  <- paste0("ind_", m_posts, " := a_", m_posts, "*b_", m_posts)
  ind_total <- paste0("ind_total := ", paste0("ind_", m_posts, collapse = " + "))
  total_def <- "total := cprime + ind_total"

  paste(c(a_lines, cor_lines, y_line, ind_defs, ind_total, total_def), collapse = "\n")
}

fit_multiM <- function(data, condition_var, y_pre, y_post, mediators_list,
                       treatment_level = "REP", boot = 5000, min_n = 25) {

  dat2 <- make_treat01(data, condition_var = condition_var, treatment_level = treatment_level)

  m_posts <- vapply(mediators_list, function(x) x[["post"]], character(1))
  m_pres  <- vapply(mediators_list, function(x) x[["pre"]],  character(1))

  needed <- unique(c("treat01", y_pre, y_post, m_pres, m_posts))
  check_vars_exist(dat2, needed)

  dat_model <- dat2 %>% filter(if_all(all_of(needed), ~ !is.na(.x)))
  if (nrow(dat_model) < min_n) return(NULL)

  model_syntax <- build_multiM_model(y_pre, y_post, mediators_list)

  sem(
    model_syntax,
    data = dat_model,
    se = "bootstrap",
    bootstrap = boot,
    missing = "listwise"
  )
}

# Example: multi-mediator model for BFS Total (returns lavaan fit object)
fit_allM_bfs_total <- fit_multiM(
  data = data,
  condition_var = condition_var,
  y_pre  = outcomes$BFS_Total$pre,
  y_post = outcomes$BFS_Total$post,
  mediators_list = mediators,
  treatment_level = treatment_level,
  boot = n_boot
)

# Optional: extract indirect totals if you fit it
if (!is.null(fit_allM_bfs_total)) {
  pe_multi <- parameterEstimates(fit_allM_bfs_total, boot.ci.type = "bca.simple")
  pe_multi %>%
    filter(label %in% c("ind_total", "total") & op == ":=") %>%
    select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper, pvalue) %>%
    print()
}

# ============================================================
# 8) Export
# ============================================================
write.csv(results_mediation, "/Users/levchenko/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/WCER/2026/REP/results_mediation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
